classifications.rationale: Every projection is explicitly relative to player 0 or player 1.
Duel option flags determine semantic zone projection and are public configuration.
Current LP is public game state.
Decision player and perspective-filtered turn/phase events populate these values; query-only callers retain explicit null.
Deck count is visible while current entries and order are never queried into entities.
Current hidden Deck order is not a player-observable fact.
Hand size is public.
Opponent hidden Hand entities are omitted; own private Hand entities remain available.
Extra Deck count is visible.
Public face-up Extra Deck cards are projected.
Opponent hidden Extra Deck identities are omitted.
Passcode is projected only when ownership/public/face-up semantics prove identity visibility.
Position and safe slot structure remain observable; hidden identity is not inferred from it.
Alias is not required for environment correctness and is absent from the semantic entity.
Current and printed identity-derived properties are absent for hidden cards; Xyz rank and Link DEF semantics are typed.
Pendulum scales are current properties only when identity/features are visible.
Link rating and marker bits are typed and exposed only for visible identity/features.
Typed counters are projected with type/count when the card is visible.
Ownership/controller relation is structural state and does not identify a hidden passcode.
Status is current card state and is withheld with hidden feature sets.
These flags are used as visibility gates and are not copied as raw engine fields.
Relationships are emitted only when both safe locators resolve.
Xyz material count is available from the parent query.

classifications.source: pinned public OCG API limitation confirmed by M2.1
classifications.rationale: Parent count/raw-code aggregate is available, but OCG_DuelQuery and OCG_DuelQueryLocation return no individual material record; M2 emits redacted material entities and explicit edges.
Raw engine causality and related hidden-card locations are not needed for the player snapshot.
Configured composition knowledge is sorted and separated from current Deck order; opponent knowledge defaults false.
Chain index, activating player, activation zone, visible source, effect description, and visible targets are structured without hidden source identity.
Only decision references and safe candidate locators are attached; complete candidates remain in DecisionRequest.
SHA-256 covers canonical perspective-safe bytes and excludes the stored hash itself.
